lines.text: Hey. I'm Jovan - Content Squad, Sprout to Flower route. Quality content can earn 15 to 40 points per piece. Weekly highlight adds more.
Depth. Content that teaches, analyzes, and gives context. Hype will not make you stand out. An honest analysis of how DUSD works can.
And visuals matter. I'm Aifilho, Creative Squad. Visual consistency is a differentiator: identity, readability, clarity.
I'm Victor de Souza - Content/Research Squad, also Sprout. I came from CEX. I thought knowing trade was enough to make technical content. It was not.
The community can feel when something is shallow. Technical depth with a human voice - that is the path.
